long_pdf_cases.method: Four real open fonts; 97/193-character 20pt stroke and filled-Bezier PDFs with original advances. Normal Converter resource loading. Frozen rc26 rescans the same saved geometry. Every glyph is checked against original font cmap/BoundsPen at its PDF position, with complete source handles/digests and saved TEXT insertion/alignment endpoints. Font files are used only to generate/audit fixtures, never by runtime recognition.

short_dxf_regression.method: Fresh recovery on the same persisted DXF inputs with all ten r2 catalogs loaded by the rc27 algorithm. Compare every existing recognition report field (the two added long-text counters are both zero) and every entitydb tag (except the validated ezdxf writer timestamp) against rc26 outputs, including original geometry, recovered TEXT, blocks and resources. Catalogs are loaded once and reused; separate full PDF conversions exercise normal uncached loading. Not a rerun of 84 PDFs.

limitation: Only publication of already matched long rows changes. Font mask/topology matching, locks and row-recheck thresholds remain unchanged. Partial cases and unconfirmed outlines are retained.
